description: This file contains acceptance test cases for the AOR_Reports module, utilizing the Codeception testing framework. It defines a class AOR_ReportsCest with multiple test scenarios for viewing, creating, editing, duplicating, and deleting reports within the module, using page object steps and Faker for test data generation.

classes.name: AOR_ReportsCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for the AOR_Reports module including scenarios for viewing, creating, editing, duplicating, and deleting reports.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Sets up fake data generator and seed before each test.

methods.name: testScenarioViewReportsModule
methods.description: Tests that an admin user can view the reports module list view.

methods.name: testScenarioCreateReport
methods.description: Tests creating a new report through the reports module.

methods.name: testScenarioViewReportFromListView
methods.description: Tests viewing a specific report from the list view.

methods.name: testScenarioEditReportFromDetailView
methods.description: Tests editing an existing report from the detail view.

methods.name: testScenarioDuplicateReportFromDetailView
methods.description: Tests duplicating an existing report from the detail view.

methods.name: testScenarioDeleteRecordFromDetailView
methods.description: Tests deleting a report from the detail view.
